newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan state being reduced slowly but surely.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan state being reduced slowly but surely.

text.p: The oversized Venezuelan state apparatus is being reduced slowly but surely, Planning Minister Teodoro Petkoff said Thursday.
"The reduction of the Venezuelan state collides with political, party and union interests, so one has to be patient, firm and tough, and tactful," Petkoff told Union Radio.
Petkoff said nine of Venezuela's 16 ministries had presented plans to reduce their personnel.
Venezuela's central government employs about 800,000 civil servants. Public sector employees as a whole, including those in state and municipal government, total 1.3 million.
"The political irresponsibility of the last 35 years produced this monster which is the Venezuelan state, with 800,000 public servants of whom a considerable proportion are not needed," Petkoff said.
